_comment: Which answers send a lead to which outcome page. The work order did not supply rules, so these are derived from what the landing page itself says ("This works if / does not work if", the footnote that turnover is checked against public records, and the wording of each outcome page). They are a proposal: change a row here and nothing else. Evaluated top to bottom, first match wins. Precedence is not-a-fit, then not-now, then review, then book: structural beats temporary, and a lead that needs a person to look at it comes after both. LAUNCH.md section 1 gives the reasoning for each rule.
